spec_fidelity: The stats sidebar is visible, but the requested connected skill tree is not functioning as the centerpiece: most nodes are pushed against or beyond the right edge, the connecting structure is barely legible, and the main canvas reads predominantly as empty space.
unity: The dark navy, gold accent, serif display type, and circular node grammar are coherent, yet the severe left-heavy sidebar versus empty canvas split prevents the screen from feeling compositionally unified.
variety: Node states differ only weakly through small icon and color changes; there is no strong root-to-branch progression, focal capstone, or scale variation to communicate skill importance and progression.
conflict: Unity favors one restrained node system, while Variety needs stronger tier and state differentiation; Fidelity also requires every important node and connection to remain visible rather than simplified away.
resolution: Keep one shared circular-node and gold/navy grammar, but create variation through semantically justified scale, luminance, and branch grouping, while fitting the entire connected matrix inside the visible main canvas.
moderator_revision: Recompose the main canvas into a fully visible centered skill tree occupying the area to the right of the sidebar: show a large root node, 2–3 clearly connected branches, several readable locked/unlocked nodes, and a distinct capstone, with no nodes clipped by the viewport. Preserve the restrained navy/gold visual system and compact the sidebar slightly, but differentiate tiers and states using deliberate node scale, ring intensity, icon treatment, and muted versus luminous fills. Add faint branch labels and stronger connector lines so the requested matrix and progression are unmistakable without introducing unrelated colors or component styles.
